minutes.headline: Commission ratified the certificate to alter for a roof reshingling and agreed to simplify its CTA process for minor work.
minutes.summary: Three commissioners met by Zoom and in person. They ratified a certificate to alter (CTA) for a house on Massachusetts Avenue, then discussed whether like-for-like shingle work should need a CTA and how the building inspector gates permits. The chair also reported on the Town Counsel meeting about demolition by neglect, the master plan steering committee, and the municipal building design committee.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to ratify a certificate to alter (CTA) for a house on Massachusetts Avenue; the vote passed.
The chair will talk with the building inspector and bring a draft two-step form for minor work to the December meeting.
The chair will sign the ratified CTA and send it to the planning office.
The chair will take the demolition-by-neglect enforcement question to Town Counsel at a meeting on 16 November.
The next meeting was set for 12 December, in person, with a historical commission presentation on Hometown Heroes banners on the agenda.

why_it_matters: Homeowners doing like-for-like work such as reshingling in the preservation district may soon face a simpler approval step, though the form is still a draft.
How the town can enforce against demolition by neglect of historic buildings is still unsettled and depends on Town Counsel's answer.
